'''Silvano Martello''' (born in Bologna, Italy) is an Italian scientist and engineer, and an Emeritus Professor of [[Operations Research]] at the [[University of Bologna]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.unibo.it/sitoweb/silvano.martello/en|title=Silvano Martello - UNIBO|accessdate=January 15, 2023}}</ref>
He is known for his research in [[Operations Research]] and [[Mathematical Programming]].
In particular, he made significant contributions in the areas of [[Knapsack Problem|knapsack]] and [[Assignment problem|assignment]] problems, [[packing problems]], and [[Vehicle Routing Problem|vehicle routing]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.scopus.com/authid/detail.uri?authorId=7004414084|title=Paolo Toth|publisher=Scopus|accessdate=January 15, 2023}}</ref>
As of 2023, he published 160 peer-reviewed articles and was cited more than 7000 times.

He was vice-president of the [[Association of European Operational Research Societies]] (EURO) from 2014 to 2017,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.euro-online.org/web/pages/404/previous-members-of-the-executive-committee|title=EURO - The Association of European Operational Research Societies - Previous members of the Executive Committee|website=www.euro-online.org}}</ref> and has been chairman of the [[European Chapter on Combinatorial Optimization]] (ECCO) since 1997.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.euro-online.org/web/ewg/9/ewg-ecco-euro-working-group-on-combinatorial-optimization|title=EURO Working Group ECCO|accessdate=January 15, 2023}}</ref>

He is editor-in-chief of [[4OR]], the joint official journal of the [[Belgian Society for Operations Research|Belgian]],
[[Société française de Recherche Opérationnelle et Aide à la Décision|French]], and
[[Italian Operations Research Society|Italian]] Operations Research Societies.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.springer.com/journal/10288/editors|title=4OR - Editors|accessdate=January 16, 2023}}</ref>

Among his PhD students are Andrew H. and Ann R. Tisch Professor [[Andrea Lodi]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://tech.cornell.edu/people/andrea-lodi/|title=Andrea Lodi - Cornell University|accessdate = January 15, 2023}}</ref> ([[Cornell Tech]]), and Professor [[Mauro dell'Amico]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://personale.unimore.it/rubrica/dettaglio/dellamic|title=Mauro dell'Amico - UNIMORE|accessdate=January 15, 2023}}</ref> ([[University of Modena and Reggio Emilia]]).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=79649|title = Paolo Toth Math Genealogy|accessdate = January 15, 2023}}</ref>

==Education and early career==

Martello graduated from the University of Bologna with a degree in [[Electronic Engineering]] in 1973.
He was an assistant and then an associate professor at the University of Bologna from 1980 to 1990.
From 1990 to 1994 he was a full professor of Operations Research and Management Science at the [[University of Turin]].
Since 1994 he is a full professor of Operations Research at the University of Bologna.

==Awards==
[[File:Silvano Martello EGM.png|thumb|alt=Silvano Martello receives the EURO Gold Medal Award from Luk Van Wassenhove|Silvano Martello (right) receives the EURO Gold Medal Award from [[Luk Van Wassenhove]] (left).]]
*2012 - [[International Federation of Operational Research Societies|IFORS]] Distinguished Lecturer.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ifors.org/ifors-distinguished-lectures/|title=IFORS Distinguished Lectures|accessdate=January 15, 2023}}</ref>
*2018 - Omega (journal) best paper award.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.journals.elsevier.com/omega/highlighted-articles/best-papers-awards-2018-omega|title=Omega Best Paper Awards 2018|accessdate=January 15, 2023}}</ref>
*2018 - [[EURO Gold Medal]] from the [[Association of European Operational Research Societies]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.euro-online.org/web/pages/1634/egm-laureate-2018|title = EURO Gold Medal 2018|accessdate = January 15, 2023}}</ref>

==Books==
He is the co-author, with [[Paolo Toth]], of the book ''Knapsack problems: Algorithms and Computer implementations'' (John Wiley & Sons, Inc., 1990).<ref>{{cite book|url= https://books.google.com/books?id=0dhQAAAAMAAJ|title= Knapsack problems: Algorithms and Computer implementations|author= Silvano Martello, and Paolo Toth|publisher= John Wiley & Sons, Inc.|date= 1990|isbn= 0471924202}}</ref>
He also co-authored, with [[Rainer Burkard]] and Mauro dell'Amico, the book ''Assignment Problems'' (SIAM, 2009).<ref>{{cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=nHIzbApLOr0C|title=Assignment Problems|author=Reiner Burkard, Silvano Martello, and Paolo Toth|publisher=SIAM|date=2009|isbn=978-0-89871-663-4}}</ref>
